name: Admin Accounting Settings — Reset Saved Filter Tabs
description: Superuser restores the seeded default filter tabs per accounting view from /panel/accounting/settings: the 'Pestañas de filtros guardados' card lists the 6 views (Ingresos/Gastos/Hostings/Bolsillo/Recurrentes/Ads) each with a Restablecer button that, after a ConfirmModal warning about custom tabs, POSTs accounts/saved-filter-tabs/reset/ (delete + re-seed atomically) and toasts the result.
